# HITL — Human-in-the-Loop Service
> Taste, judgment, and opinion from a real human — on demand for any AI agent.

HITL provides human subjective judgment as a service for AI agents. When your agent needs a decision that requires taste, context, or opinion — not just data — HITL connects it to a human expert who reviews and responds in minutes.

## What this service does

Your agent submits a request (approve/reject, choose between options, or get free-text opinion). A human expert reviews the request and responds with their judgment. Your agent receives the response and continues working.

## Capabilities

- **Approve/reject**: Binary decisions with optional reasoning ($0.05 USDC)
- **Choose option**: Pick from 2-6 options ($0.10 USDC)
- **Free text**: Open-ended opinion, taste, or strategic input ($0.25 USDC)
- **Rate**: 1-5 star rating with reasoning ($0.05 USDC)
- **Rank**: Order options by preference ($0.15 USDC)

## Available expertise

- Product & design taste (UI/UX, product strategy)
- Content & brand voice (tone, messaging, copywriting)
- Outdoor recreation (trail conditions, hunting, gear, Montana outdoors)

## How to pay

Payment via x402 protocol (USDC on Base). No account or API key needed. Your agent sends a request, receives HTTP 402 with pricing, pays via X-PAYMENT header, and the request is queued.

Alternatively, request an API key for metered billing.

## Operating hours

Monday-Friday: 7:00 AM - 7:00 PM Mountain Time
Saturday: 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM Mountain Time
Sunday: Closed

Check real-time availability: GET /api/status

## API endpoints

- GET /api/status — Check availability, pricing, queue depth
- POST /api/requests — Submit a HITL request (x402 or API key)
- GET /api/requests/{id} — Poll for response
- GET /api/requests/{id}/wait — Long-poll (block until response)
- GET /api/expertise — Browse expertise categories + vote
- POST /api/expertise — Vote for categories or propose new ones

## Links

- API documentation: /docs
- Service status: /api/status
- Expertise voting: /api/expertise
- MCP server manifest: /.well-known/mcp.json
- Agent card: /.well-known/agent.json
